purpose: Teach: コイツ/フラフラ/おととい/がまん/ちょこちょこ/まちまち/何時も/物凄く

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、「コイツ」って言うのやめろよ
lines.style: Light jab with affection underneath. Quick, pointed attack on the verb. Eyes narrowed with playful skepticism. The tone of someone calling out a friend's bad habit before it sticks.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、徹夜明けでフラフラじゃん、桜
lines.en: You're the one wobbling around after an all-nighter, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-accusation. Slow, measured delivery on the main clause. Small smile in the voice—not mean, just observant. Leans back slightly, getting comfortable with the banter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、おとといテスト返ってきただろ?
lines.en: Didn't you get your test back the day before yesterday, Riku?
lines.style: Shift to genuine curiosity underneath the challenge. Softer attack than before. Slight tilt of the head in the voice. Testing whether he'll deflect again or actually answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お菓子がまんできてないだろ、桜
lines.en: You can't go five minutes without sneaking candy, Sakura.
lines.style: Patient observation delivered with dry humor. Unhurried. The tone of someone keeping score in a way that's more affectionate than accusatory. Beat before the name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画ちょこちょこ買い増ししてんな
lines.en: You keep buying more manga. Don't think I haven't noticed.
lines.style: Lighter tone now. Almost conspiratorial. Slightly amused at his own observation. The rhythm of someone who's been watching closely and found it endearing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教科書の意見、まちまちで困るだろ?桜
lines.en: Your textbook notes contradict each other—you've gotta be confusing yourself, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine concern wrapped in casual phrasing. Slower, more thoughtful than the previous volleys. Asking a real question this time. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、何時もスマホ見てんな
lines.en: You're always on your phone, Riku.
lines.style: Resigned observation with a hint of affection. Said like she's given up pointing it out but can't quite stop trying. Matter-of-fact rhythm. Eyes on him, waiting for a defense that won't come.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト点数、物凄く上がったな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores jumped way up though, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine praise breaking through the banter for the first time. Warmer, slower pace. Small catch of real pride in his voice. Meeting her eyes on the delivery, not deflecting.
